jobs.title: Head of Data Systems (Google Stack)
jobs.description:
The Head of Data Systems (Google Stack) will play a key role at Stacktics, required to help create and maintain industry-leading quality and efficiency of service and software delivery.

Stacktics will rely on the Head of Data Systems with ownership of the Data Systems function including mentoring and support for our team of engineers, developers, marketing analysts and data scientists. The successful candidate will be expected to meet and exceed Stacktics' quality standards, while helping the organization rapidly expand into increasingly complex application development, data engineering, and related workflows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ownership of Stacktics' Data Systems Business Unit

Build and grow your team's capabilities and expertise to be truly platform-agnostic, ever-adapting based on opportunity and business direction
Lead thorough audits of clients'/prospects' Data Systems, and other associated platforms and technologies as applicable including performance and cloud cost-efficiency
Provide proactive recommendations, identifying areas of opportunity and/or improvement for clients based on their underlying business objectives and goals
Maintain continuous focus on work output quality and reliability, acting as the champion of customer satisfaction in a proactive manner and as the final escalation point for technical and delivery issues that cannot be resolved at the Technical Lead level
Act as Stacktics' primary Data Systems expert, ensuring to maintain and continuously grow personal expertise, and sharing information with other Stacktics team members, client stakeholders and prospects
Collaborate with, support, and work closely with cross-functional units to ensure efficient workflow, and realize cross-functional opportunities and enhancements
Maintain responsibility for the Business Unit's growth and success, continuously developing existing engagements, optimizing resourcing and prospecting
Be dedicated to the success and happiness of your team members, optimizing workflow, enabling their personal growth, and acting as a strong team leader overall

Instilling Development Best Practices and Skills/Procedures Advancement

Establishing, maintaining and evolving DevSecOps best practices and tools, and continuously keeping them aligned with current industry best practices and procedures
Understanding, implementing and automating security controls, governance processes, and compliance validation frameworks
Contributing to deployment tooling within the Stacktics team
Contributing to version control technology frameworks and creating/implementing working processes within the Data Systems team, with tools such as Git or SVN
Own and continuously improve the practice's AI coding standards, the AI coding constitution (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules), PR checklists, and slash commands keeping them current as tools, clients, and the team's needs evolve

Leading in the Software 3.0 Era

AI tools have changed how fast engineering work gets produced. Your job is to make sure that speed shows up as sounder architecture and higher-quality delivery — not just faster shipping of the same judgment gaps.
Recalibrate how the team scopes and estimates work as AI tooling changes what can actually be delivered in a sprint, so timelines and resourcing plans reflect real AI-era delivery speed
Set architecture and coding standards that assume engineers are using AI assistants daily — code review habits, eval frameworks, and quality gates sized to the failure modes of AI-assisted development, not just its speed
Continue evolving Stacktics' AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC) — our AI-native answer to SDLC — piloting new stages against real engagements and driving adoption across the team
Be an active daily user of AI coding assistants yourself, and bring that firsthand experience into how standards and review practices are set for the team
Lead Stacktics’ technical team members through the integration into Agentic AI-first working patterns, and beyond

Code Productization

Migrating the delivery of the most common/universally applicable solutions from custom projects to formally productized software solutions
Advocating for building repeatability, scalability and standardization into how the Stacktics Data Systems team approaches all work, in order to enable the future migration to productization as a general rule

Data Engineering-Specific Responsibilities

Participate in continuous delivery pipelines to fully automate deployment of the highly available cloud platform that supports multiple projects
Design and develop ETL workflows and datasets to be used in data visualization tools
Write complex SQL queries with multiple joins to automate and manipulate data extracts
Perform end to end Data Validation to maintain accuracy of data sets
Build tools for deployment, monitoring and operations
Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the development, test and production environments
Develop re-usable processes that can be leveraged and standardized for multiple instances
Prepare technical specifications and documentation for projects
Stay up to date on relevant technologies, plug into user groups, understand trends and opportunities to ensure we are using the best possible techniques and tools
Understand, implement, and automate security controls, governance processes, and compliance validation

Contribution to Corporate Strategy

Actively and proactively play a key role in steering Stacktics and affiliated companies, considering market developments, competitive maneuvers, unique opportunities, etc.
You will be expected to both bring new ideas to the table and assist other corporate leaders in vetting/developing concepts and tactics
Identification and tracking of performance, coaching, training needs, and motivating members of the Data Systems team — including Senior Technical Leads. Directly or indirectly responsible for hiring, terminating and owning performance evaluations for direct reports and the Data Systems group

Company-Wide Responsibilities

Maintain and exceed client satisfaction with Stacktics’ deliverables, day-to-day work and overall value as a partner
Adapt to ever-changing client needs and expectations
Maintain dedication toward achieving excellence in Stacktics’ delivery against client needs, and overall success as an organization
Ability to provide clear guidance and support for advanced problem solving and system design to large teams at enterprise-level client companies, aiding the evolution of their digital practices

QUALIFICATIONS

Deep expertise in building and managing large-scale data systems on cloud platforms, with a strong preference for Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services
Python, SQL and Cloud Computing
10+ years experience in Data Engineering, including 6+ years in technical leadership or management roles, with experience managing other leads (e.g., Technical Leads or engineering managers).
Strong understanding of and direct experience with managing a team operating in a “Software 3.0” model (Agentic AI-first)
Active user of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent), and fluent in what they change about estimation, architecture, and review
Understanding of digital ecosystems including online data collection, cloud systems and analytics tools (Google Stack, Facebook, Salesforce, Adobe Suite etc.) a strong asset
Strong technical understanding of a range of marketing concepts such as cookie-based data collection, setting and leveraging audience segments, attribution modelling, AB/N & multivariate is an asset
Excellent written & verbal communication skills are essential; candidate should be comfortable presenting and participating in group discussions of concepts with internal and external stakeholders
Candidate must exhibit an analytical, detail-oriented approach to problem solving
Experience with Jira / Atlassian project management tools is an asset

Preferred Qualifications

Google Cloud certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer) are a strong plus.
Prior experience in a consulting environment, managing and delivering projects for multiple clients concurrently.

jobs.title: Director of AI
jobs.description:
About Apply

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com .

LOCATION:
APPLY is hybrid/remote friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Canada, working in hours that align to ET (Eastern Timezone) or PT (Pacific Timezone).

THE ROLE:

Are you an experienced AI engineering leader who can turn complex business problems into reliable, production-ready AI solutions? Do you enjoy working directly with clients while staying close enough to the technology to shape architectures, guide engineers, and resolve critical delivery challenges?

APPLY is seeking a Director of AI to lead the design and delivery of AI-enabled products and platforms across client engagements. This senior, client-facing role combines AI and software engineering expertise with consulting judgment, product thinking, and technical leadership.

You will help clients move from AI ambition to working solutions—from identifying valuable opportunities and rapidly validating ideas to engineering, deploying, and operating secure, scalable AI applications. You will serve as a senior technical authority while contributing hands-on expertise through architecture, prototyping, technical reviews, and delivery oversight.

You will also help advance APPLY’s AI engineering capability by developing reusable patterns, standards, accelerators, and delivery practices.

Responsibilities

Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and delivery of AI applications from discovery and experimentation through production and scale.
Work with client executives, product leaders, architects, and engineering teams to identify valuable AI opportunities and translate them into achievable technical roadmaps.
Design AI applications that combine models, enterprise data, APIs, software components, user experiences, and human workflows.
Guide the implementation of agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise search, predictive models, and AI capabilities embedded in digital products.
Determine when to use deterministic software, machine learning, large language models, human review, or a combination of approaches.
Establish evaluation-driven development practices, including test datasets, error analysis, deterministic checks, model-based evaluation, and business outcome measurement.
Ensure solutions meet production requirements for reliability, observability, scalability, latency, maintainability, security, and cost.
Guide practices for CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, monitoring, tracing, regression testing, and ongoing optimization.
Provide hands-on technical leadership through prototyping, architecture reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and delivery oversight.
Use AI-assisted development and coding agents effectively while maintaining appropriate verification, security, and human oversight.
Support proposals, discovery workshops, solution design, estimates, and executive presentations.
Develop reusable AI engineering patterns, reference architectures, accelerators, and delivery standards.
Contribute to hiring, technical mentorship, and the continued growth of APPLY’s AI capability.

Requirements

10+ years of experience across software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, or related technology disciplines, including significant experience leading AI or ML solutions.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating AI or machine learning applications in production—not only proofs of concept.
Strong software engineering foundation, including system design, APIs, data architecture, testing, security, cloud infrastructure, and production operations.
Hands-on proficiency in Python and experience with modern application, data, and AI engineering frameworks.
Strong understanding of LLMs, RAG, context engineering, agentic workflows, tool use, structured outputs, and model evaluation.
Experience grounding AI systems in enterprise data, including structured data, documents, semantic models, vector stores, or knowledge graphs.
Experience establishing evaluation and error-analysis practices for systems with probabilistic outputs.
Ability to balance model quality, reliability, latency, cost, security, and user experience.
Experience with cloud-native architecture and production deployment on GCP, AWS, or Azure.
Familiarity with containers, CI/CD, observability, and MLOps or LLMOps practices.
Demonstrated success in a consulting, professional-services, or complex client-facing environment.
Ability to move comfortably between executive conversations, product decisions, architecture discussions, and detailed technical problem-solving.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
A degree in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, data science, or a related field—or equivalent professional experience.

NICE TO HAVES

Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated, privacy-sensitive, or large-scale enterprise environments.
Experience with model fine-tuning, open-source models, multimodal AI, voice agents, or computer-use agents.
Experience implementing enterprise AI security controls, including prompt-injection defenses, tool permissions, and human approval gates.
Experience building internal AI platforms, reusable agent frameworks, or developer enablement capabilities.
Experience contributing to organizational AI strategy, operating models, or technical standards.
Professional certifications or significant delivery experience with GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable platforms.

LIFE AT APPLY

People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:

Agentic Delivery:
Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.

An inclusive and safe environment:
We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe.

AI & Strategic Upskilling:
Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work.

Generous vacation policy:
Work-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer flexible personal time off (PTO); allowing ample time away from work to promote overall well-being.

Customizable benefits:
Tailor your extended health and dental plan to your needs, priorities, and preferences.

Flexible work arrangements:
We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both.

APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email [email protected] .

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing Technology
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Enverta Digital, part of Havas CX Canada, is looking for a technically confident leader to strengthen delivery across development, campaign management, platform implementations and platform and data integrations.

You will lead an eight-person team spanning development, campaign management and platform consulting, helping enterprise clients connect customer data with effective engagement through Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement and Salesforce Data Cloud.

The role will also support delivery across Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys (CIJ). Experience with these platforms is welcomed as an asset, with Salesforce remaining the primary focus.
Reporting to the SVP, Technology Strategy & Delivery, and working closely with the Head of Architecture, you will guide day-to-day execution, develop team capabilities and help ensure client solutions are delivered with quality and consistency.

Your primary focus will be leadership and technical oversight, with hands-on involvement when needed to review work, resolve complex issues and support the team. You will also help advance our capabilities in Salesforce Agentforce, agentic AI and connected customer experiences.

What you will do

Lead and develop the team

Manage and coach functional leads and platform consultants across development, campaign management and platform delivery.
Establish clear priorities, expectations and accountability, supporting performance management, career development and hiring.
Work with functional leads and project managers to align team capacity and skills with client priorities.

Manage implementations and integrations

Manage delivery of assigned platform implementations, enhancements, and platform and data integrations with the delivery teams.
Translate client requirements and architectural direction into actionable implementation plans, estimates and acceptance criteria.
Partner closely with the Head of Architecture to align implementation decisions with solution design and technical standards.
Work with project and account teams to manage dependencies, identify risks and maintain realistic delivery commitments.
Lead client discussions within your remit, communicate recommendations and resolve delivery issues.
Coordinate with the QA team on test planning, defect resolution and release readiness, ensuring delivery teams provide the documentation and support needed for effective validation.
Ensure clear deployment plans, operational documentation and handover to support teams.

Provide technical leadership

Guide delivery across campaigns, journeys, segmentation, personalization and automation.
Guide platform & data implementation and activation, including data ingestion, mapping, identity resolution, segmentation and connections to engagement platforms.
Oversee technical execution of integrations between Salesforce, other platforms and enterprise data sources, including validation, monitoring and exception handling.
Review configurations, campaign logic, SQL and data flows, contributing hands-on when needed to investigate issues and validate fixes.
Work with architecture, QA and client stakeholders to embed consent, security and data-handling requirements into delivery.

Improve delivery and build capability

Strengthen development, implementation, documentation and deployment practices in partnership with functional leads, Architecture and QA.
Reduce recurring issues and avoidable rework through better processes, reusable solutions and team development.
Help identify and deliver practical applications of Salesforce Agentforce, agentic AI and automation.
Partner with architecture and technical specialists to evaluate new capabilities, working with QA to establish appropriate validation before release.

What success looks like

Team members and functional leads have clear priorities, accountability and development goals.
Platform implementations, integrations and campaign work progress reliably, with risks surfaced early and issues resolved effectively.
Delivery teams and QA collaborate effectively, with clear acceptance criteria, timely defect resolution and well-supported release decisions.
Architecture, development, campaign management and platform consulting teams work together effectively.
The team becomes more capable and independent, with fewer recurring defects and less avoidable rework.
Clients have confidence in your technical guidance and delivery communication.

Required qualifications:

5+ years of experience in MarTech, Salesforce, CRM, marketing automation, loyalty, customer engagement platforms, or technical consulting.
Hands-on experience implementing or supporting platforms such as Salesforce Data Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Engagement, Salesforce Loyalty Management, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Braze, or similar technologies.
Strong practical understanding of MarTech platform configuration, segmentation, personalization, customer journeys, campaign activation, and platform QA.
Ability to translate requirements into platform configurations, user stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, technical documentation, and implementation guidance.
Experience working with developers, QA teams, platform specialists, campaign teams, architects, product owners, analysts, and business stakeholders.
Experience leading or coordinating technical delivery across small teams or pods.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot delivery issues across systems.
Ability to work onsite at client offices in Toronto 1-2 days per week.

About us:

Enverta Digital is a marketing technology and customer engagement consultancy, now part of Havas CX Canada. We specialize in CRM strategy, marketing operations, and MarTech enablement, helping brands design and deliver personalized, data-driven customer experiences across channels. Backed by Havas’ global network, Enverta combines deep platform expertise with creative and strategic capabilities to drive measurable business impact.

Our Perks:

At Havas Canada our people come first which is why we offer a comprehensive total rewards package including:
Centralized Downtown Office
Hybrid working environment
Physical & Mental Health Benefits
Dedicated Culture Committee & Diversity Team
Growth Opportunities & Employer-Paid Professional Development
Generous Flex-Time off policy
Paid Parental Top-Up Policy
Dog friendly office

Additional Information:

This role represents an active vacancy at Havas. You will be joining a collaborative, growth-oriented environment where ideas are encouraged and career development is supported. The base salary range for this position is CAD $130,000 to $160,000, with final compensation determined based on factors such as work location, skills, experience, and background.

jobs.title: Director, Platform Systems
jobs.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

YOUR IMPACT

OpenText is looking for an experienced and collaborative technology leader to join our Corporate IT organization as Director, Platform Systems
. In this global leadership role, you will be responsible for the strategy, delivery, and operational excellence of critical enterprise capabilities across Integration Systems, Security and Identity Access Management, and Fulfillment Systems. You will lead distributed teams, partner with business and technology stakeholders, and help modernize the systems and practices that enable secure, scalable, and efficient business operations.

What The Role Offers

Leading and influencing in a global, matrixed environment with teams and stakeholders across multiple regions.
Manage budgets, vendor relationships, licensing decisions, and platform investments with a focus on business value, simplification, and cost effectiveness.
Work with technologies that may include Cloud Integration Hub/ICDM, SAP PI/PO, SAP Integration Suite/BTP, Boomi, MuleSoft, Google Cloud Platform, IAM platforms, licensing and fulfillment systems, APIs, automation, and observability tools.
Building trusted relationships with business partners, technology leaders, architects, cybersecurity teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and consultants.
Communicating clearly with executive, business, technical, and operational audiences.
Bringing structure, transparency, and prioritization to complex portfolios of work.
Driving Agile ways of working, delivery predictability, team accountability, and continuous improvement.
Applying AI and automation thoughtfully to improve speed, quality, operational insight, documentation, testing, and productivity.
Balancing strategic planning with hands-on leadership in a fast-paced, business-critical environment.
Simplifying technology landscapes, reducing risk, improving resilience, and aligning work to measurable outcomes.
Promoting strong development, integration, security, identity, fulfillment, documentation, and operational practices.
Staying current on emerging trends in integration platforms, IAM, application security, fulfillment, cloud, APIs, AI, and automation.

What You Need To Succeed

10+ years of progressive experience leading application, development, enterprise systems, integration, security, identity, fulfillment, or platform teams.
Demonstrated experience leading global teams, managing multiple workstreams, and delivering business-critical technology services.
Strong technical leadership experience across enterprise integration platforms, API management, cloud integration, SAP integration technologies, IAM tools, fulfillment or licensing systems, and modern application delivery practices.
Agile training or certification is required; hands-on experience leading Agile teams, Scrum practices, backlog management, delivery metrics, and Agile maturity improvement is strongly preferred.
Working knowledge of AI capabilities and practical use cases in Integration, Security, Identity Management, and Fulfillment Systems, including automation, developer productivity, observability, testing, application security, and operational efficiency.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business language.
Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, performance management, talent development, succession planning, and building engaged teams.
Strong analytical, negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed environment while maintaining delivery discipline, operational rigor, and stakeholder confidence.
Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, enterprise transformation, or major technology modernization initiatives is an asset.
High-tech software or enterprise software industry experience is an asset.
A relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree, college diploma, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

One Last Thing

OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned.

Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.

OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket at Ask HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

Compensation:
At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off.

Salary Range:
Depending on the candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market, actual salary may vary and be higher or lower than the range posted.

AI Usage Disclosure:
As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. jobs.description:
Associate Director, Strategy (Ecommerce)

Job Details

Role:
Associate Director, Strategy (Ecommerce)

Department
: Performance

Job Location:
Remote (Canada)

Role Type:
Full-Time, Permanent

Hours:
Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Starting New Hire Pay:
$112,000 - $130,000 CAD + Benefits

Full Pay Band:
$112,000 - $151,000 CAD + Profit Sharing (after 1 year of employment) + Benefits

Role Availability:
This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around ecommerce, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside. Think breakout DTC and omnichannel consumer brands, the ones already in your cart, your closet and your feed, whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them. You'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how paid media compounds into revenue, customer lifetime value and durable, profitable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we acquire new customers profitably, know which spend is truly incremental, and scale without giving up margin? The tactical craft matters (shopping feeds, creative testing, ROAS, CAC and MER performance), but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most exciting consumer brands out there grow. If your idea of success starts and ends with in-platform ROAS, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about ecommerce as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department as Associate Director, Strategy, you’ll deliver strategic leadership to performance teams, leveraging industry trends to evolve Thrive’s services and client marketing strategies. You’ll partner closely with leadership to align team goals with company growth, while managing key relationships and ensuring the long-term success of high-complexity, projects and prospects.

Your focus of responsibilities will be:

Domain:
Recognized as a leader in performance marketing both within Thrive and in the industry, you make expert contributions to the Performance department, ensuring long-term project success and enhancing the skills of those involved.
Client:
Championing client success as the hands-on strategic lead across large, multi-faceted accounts, digging into performance, solving problems directly, and refining processes across projects and teams to strengthen client partnerships and retention.
People:
Manage a team of senior performance marketers and act as an advocate at scale. Helping others elevate their performance marketing skills or add new skills to their toolkit for project growth and performance. You lead a results-driven culture that in turn leads to consistent and measurable growth.
Company:
Support senior leadership in the Performance department and collaborate with other supporting function leaders to develop, set and execute the roadmap for Thrive's short to long-term performance marketing product and services plans.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

In your first 30 days you’ll
become familiar with Thrive’s tools, processes, and expectations for high-complexity accounts, while building relationships across Performance leadership, strategists, and key cross-functional partners.
In your first 60 days you’ll
begin actively contributing strategic input across high-complexity accounts, supporting key client moments alongside account leaders, and identifying early opportunities to strengthen delivery consistency, team workflow, or performance standards.
In your first 90 days you’ll
step into leading high-impact client moments for high-complexity accounts, demonstrate measurable impact through improved team execution and client outcomes.

Qualifications

You’ve led and owned large-scale, multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing programs with monthly media spend exceeding $1M USD, driving sustained performance across platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).
You’ve led and developed multi-level teams of 15+, including managing managers, setting performance standards, and scaling team impact through others.
You’ve designed and evolved performance reporting and dashboards (using tools like Looker, Google Sheets, Excel, Tableau…) that enable clear decision-making, executive communication, and accountability against business KPIs.
You’ve led initiatives and process improvements adopted at the department or company level, raising performance standards and operational consistency.
You’ve owned performance strategy across diverse business models, leading forecasting, pacing, and measurement while confidently advising senior and C-suite executive stakeholders.
You’ve led complex client relationships with multiple senior executive stakeholders, navigating high-stakes situations and driving buy-in through clear, confident communication and strategic recommendations.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

Greater Toronto Area

The Opportunity
Our client, an established and growing third-party logistics organization in the Greater Toronto Area, is looking for an experienced Director of Finance
to join its leadership team.
This is a hands-on senior finance position for someone who enjoys being close to the business. Commercial Finance & Profitability
Work closely with operational and commercial teams to understand the financial performance of customers, lanes, services, and contracts.
Provide financial oversight related to transportation costs, pricing, and margin performance.
Review costing information and identify areas where profitability can be improved.
Support pricing decisions, customer proposals, bids, and contract renewals.

Business & Operational Partnership
Partner with Operations and Transportation leaders to ensure financial information accurately reflects business activity.
Provide financial guidance on operational decisions, service costs, and customer requirements.
Work with Sales on the financial components of new business opportunities and customer agreements.
Develop and monitor KPIs related to financial and operational performance.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate financial data into practical recommendations for the leadership team.

Payroll, Compliance & Risk
Provide oversight of payroll administration and related reporting requirements.
Ensure appropriate remittances, tax filings, and regulatory requirements are completed accurately and on time.
Maintain strong financial documentation and ensure the organization remains audit-ready.
Monitor areas of financial and operational risk and ensure appropriate controls are in place.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement
Coach, develop, and support members of the finance team.
Evaluate existing financial processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and reporting.
Support improvements to accounting, transportation, and business systems.
Participate in system implementations and integrations, with a focus on data integrity and effective financial reporting.
Introduce tools, reporting, and automation that provide leadership with better and faster business information.

Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline.
CPA designation strongly preferred.

Progressive experience in accounting and financial leadership within 3PL, transportation, logistics, distribution, or a similar operational environment
.

within an operational business.

Strong Excel skills and experience working with accounting and ERP systems.

The Ideal Candidate

You understand the importance of costing and margin visibility in a high-volume logistics environment and can turn financial information into practical business decisions.

This opportunity is well suited to someone who has built their career within a 3PL, transportation, logistics, distribution, or similarly fast-paced operational business

The successful candidate will be expected to meet and exceed Stacktics' quality standards, while helping the organization rapidly expand into increasingly complex application development, data engineering, and related workflows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ownership of Stacktics' Data Systems Business Unit

Build and grow your team's capabilities and expertise to be truly platform-agnostic, ever-adapting based on opportunity and business direction
Lead thorough audits of clients'/prospects' Data Systems, and other associated platforms and technologies as applicable including performance and cloud cost-efficiency
Provide proactive recommendations, identifying areas of opportunity and/or improvement for clients based on their underlying business objectives and goals

Act as Stacktics' primary Data Systems expert, ensuring to maintain and continuously grow personal expertise, and sharing information with other Stacktics team members, client stakeholders and prospects
Collaborate with, support, and work closely with cross-functional units to ensure efficient workflow, and realize cross-functional opportunities and enhancements
Maintain responsibility for the Business Unit's growth and success, continuously developing existing engagements, optimizing resourcing and prospecting
Be dedicated to the success and happiness of your team members, optimizing workflow, enabling their personal growth, and acting as a strong team leader overall

Instilling Development Best Practices and Skills/Procedures Advancement

Establishing, maintaining and evolving DevSecOps best practices and tools, and continuously keeping them aligned with current industry best practices and procedures
Understanding, implementing and automating security controls, governance processes, and compliance validation frameworks

new_jobs.title: Director of AI
new_jobs.description:
About Apply

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com .

LOCATION:
APPLY is hybrid/remote friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Canada, working in hours that align to ET (Eastern Timezone) or PT (Pacific Timezone).

THE ROLE:

Are you an experienced AI engineering leader who can turn complex business problems into reliable, production-ready AI solutions? Do you enjoy working directly with clients while staying close enough to the technology to shape architectures, guide engineers, and resolve critical delivery challenges?

APPLY is seeking a Director of AI to lead the design and delivery of AI-enabled products and platforms across client engagements. This senior, client-facing role combines AI and software engineering expertise with consulting judgment, product thinking, and technical leadership.

You will help clients move from AI ambition to working solutions—from identifying valuable opportunities and rapidly validating ideas to engineering, deploying, and operating secure, scalable AI applications. You will serve as a senior technical authority while contributing hands-on expertise through architecture, prototyping, technical reviews, and delivery oversight.

You will also help advance APPLY’s AI engineering capability by developing reusable patterns, standards, accelerators, and delivery practices.

Responsibilities

Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and delivery of AI applications from discovery and experimentation through production and scale.
Work with client executives, product leaders, architects, and engineering teams to identify valuable AI opportunities and translate them into achievable technical roadmaps.
Design AI applications that combine models, enterprise data, APIs, software components, user experiences, and human workflows.
Guide the implementation of agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise search, predictive models, and AI capabilities embedded in digital products.
Determine when to use deterministic software, machine learning, large language models, human review, or a combination of approaches.
Establish evaluation-driven development practices, including test datasets, error analysis, deterministic checks, model-based evaluation, and business outcome measurement.
Ensure solutions meet production requirements for reliability, observability, scalability, latency, maintainability, security, and cost.
Guide practices for CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, monitoring, tracing, regression testing, and ongoing optimization.
Provide hands-on technical leadership through prototyping, architecture reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and delivery oversight.
Use AI-assisted development and coding agents effectively while maintaining appropriate verification, security, and human oversight.
Support proposals, discovery workshops, solution design, estimates, and executive presentations.
Develop reusable AI engineering patterns, reference architectures, accelerators, and delivery standards.
Contribute to hiring, technical mentorship, and the continued growth of APPLY’s AI capability.

Requirements

10+ years of experience across software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, or related technology disciplines, including significant experience leading AI or ML solutions.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating AI or machine learning applications in production—not only proofs of concept.
Strong software engineering foundation, including system design, APIs, data architecture, testing, security, cloud infrastructure, and production operations.
Hands-on proficiency in Python and experience with modern application, data, and AI engineering frameworks.
Strong understanding of LLMs, RAG, context engineering, agentic workflows, tool use, structured outputs, and model evaluation.
Experience grounding AI systems in enterprise data, including structured data, documents, semantic models, vector stores, or knowledge graphs.
Experience establishing evaluation and error-analysis practices for systems with probabilistic outputs.
Ability to balance model quality, reliability, latency, cost, security, and user experience.
Experience with cloud-native architecture and production deployment on GCP, AWS, or Azure.
Familiarity with containers, CI/CD, observability, and MLOps or LLMOps practices.
Demonstrated success in a consulting, professional-services, or complex client-facing environment.
Ability to move comfortably between executive conversations, product decisions, architecture discussions, and detailed technical problem-solving.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
A degree in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, data science, or a related field—or equivalent professional experience.

NICE TO HAVES

Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated, privacy-sensitive, or large-scale enterprise environments.
Experience with model fine-tuning, open-source models, multimodal AI, voice agents, or computer-use agents.
Experience implementing enterprise AI security controls, including prompt-injection defenses, tool permissions, and human approval gates.
Experience building internal AI platforms, reusable agent frameworks, or developer enablement capabilities.
Experience contributing to organizational AI strategy, operating models, or technical standards.
Professional certifications or significant delivery experience with GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable platforms.

LIFE AT APPLY

People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:

Agentic Delivery:
Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.

An inclusive and safe environment:
We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe.

AI & Strategic Upskilling:
Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work.

Generous vacation policy:
Work-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer flexible personal time off (PTO); allowing ample time away from work to promote overall well-being.

Customizable benefits:
Tailor your extended health and dental plan to your needs, priorities, and preferences.

Flexible work arrangements:
We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both.

APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email [email protected] .

Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around ecommerce, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside. Think breakout DTC and omnichannel consumer brands, the ones already in your cart, your closet and your feed, whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them. You'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how paid media compounds into revenue, customer lifetime value and durable, profitable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we acquire new customers profitably, know which spend is truly incremental, and scale without giving up margin? The tactical craft matters (shopping feeds, creative testing, ROAS, CAC and MER performance), but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most exciting consumer brands out there grow. If your idea of success starts and ends with in-platform ROAS, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about ecommerce as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department as Associate Director, Strategy, you’ll deliver strategic leadership to performance teams, leveraging industry trends to evolve Thrive’s services and client marketing strategies. You’ll partner closely with leadership to align team goals with company growth, while managing key relationships and ensuring the long-term success of high-complexity, projects and prospects.

Your focus of responsibilities will be:

Domain:
Recognized as a leader in performance marketing both within Thrive and in the industry, you make expert contributions to the Performance department, ensuring long-term project success and enhancing the skills of those involved.
Client:
Championing client success as the hands-on strategic lead across large, multi-faceted accounts, digging into performance, solving problems directly, and refining processes across projects and teams to strengthen client partnerships and retention.
People:
Manage a team of senior performance marketers and act as an advocate at scale. Helping others elevate their performance marketing skills or add new skills to their toolkit for project growth and performance. You lead a results-driven culture that in turn leads to consistent and measurable growth.
Company:
Support senior leadership in the Performance department and collaborate with other supporting function leaders to develop, set and execute the roadmap for Thrive's short to long-term performance marketing product and services plans.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

In your first 30 days you’ll
become familiar with Thrive’s tools, processes, and expectations for high-complexity accounts, while building relationships across Performance leadership, strategists, and key cross-functional partners.
In your first 60 days you’ll
begin actively contributing strategic input across high-complexity accounts, supporting key client moments alongside account leaders, and identifying early opportunities to strengthen delivery consistency, team workflow, or performance standards.
In your first 90 days you’ll
step into leading high-impact client moments for high-complexity accounts, demonstrate measurable impact through improved team execution and client outcomes.

Qualifications

You’ve led and owned large-scale, multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing programs with monthly media spend exceeding $1M USD, driving sustained performance across platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).
You’ve led and developed multi-level teams of 15+, including managing managers, setting performance standards, and scaling team impact through others.
You’ve designed and evolved performance reporting and dashboards (using tools like Looker, Google Sheets, Excel, Tableau…) that enable clear decision-making, executive communication, and accountability against business KPIs.
You’ve led initiatives and process improvements adopted at the department or company level, raising performance standards and operational consistency.
You’ve owned performance strategy across diverse business models, leading forecasting, pacing, and measurement while confidently advising senior and C-suite executive stakeholders.
You’ve led complex client relationships with multiple senior executive stakeholders, navigating high-stakes situations and driving buy-in through clear, confident communication and strategic recommendations.
